slides.title: A Sniffle in Sunny Forest
slides.text: Bella Bear walked in Sunny Forest. The morning sun was soft and warm. She hummed a happy tune. "Kind hearts make happy days!" she said. Then she heard a little sniffle. Bella looked around. There was her friend, Squeaky Squirrel. He sat under a big nut tree. Squeaky looked very sad.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear walks happily in Sunny Forest on a sunny morning and finds her friend Squeaky looking sad under a nut tree.

slides.title: High Up Nuts
slides.text: Bella went closer to Squeaky. "What is wrong, dear friend?" she asked softly. Squeaky looked up at a high branch. "The best nuts are so high!" he squeaked. His little paws tried to reach. But they were too short. Squeaky felt a bit sad and hungry.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella talks to Squeaky Squirrel, who points sadly at nuts high up in a tree, showing his small paws cannot reach them.

slides.title: Bella's Kind Idea
slides.text: Bella looked at the very high nuts. She saw Squeaky's sad, droopy face. "Hmm," Bella thought. "Kind hearts make happy days!" She looked at a strong branch. It was not too high for her. Bella had an idea to help her friend.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear looks at the high nuts and Squeaky's sad face, then gets a kind idea to help by looking at a lower branch.

slides.title: Nuts Come Falling Down
slides.text: Bella stood on her tiptoes. She reached up with her paw. She gave the strong branch a gentle shake. *Thump, thump!* Many round, tasty nuts fell down. They landed softly on the grass. Squeaky's eyes grew wide. He jumped up and down with joy.
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear gently shakes a tree branch, and many nuts fall to the ground. Squeaky Squirrel looks surprised and happy.

slides.title: Thank You, Bella!
slides.text: Squeaky picked up the tasty nuts. He held one tight in his little paws. "Thank you, Bella! Thank you so much!" he chirped loudly. Bella smiled her big, gentle smile. "You are most welcome, Squeaky!" she said. Her kind heart felt very happy.
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky Squirrel happily gathers nuts and thanks Bella Bear, who smiles gently, feeling good about helping her friend.

slides.title: Happy Hearts
slides.text: The sun shone even brighter now. Squeaky offered Bella a nut. "For you!" he said. Bella and Squeaky ate the yummy nuts together. Bella knew saying "thank you" made Squeaky's heart happy. And her kind heart felt happy too. Kind hearts make happy days!
slides.speaker_notes: Bella Bear and Squeaky Squirrel share nuts under the brighter sun, both feeling happy and thankful for their friendship.

publishing.instagram_caption_long:
Join Bella Bear in Wonderwood Valley's Sunny Forest! One beautiful morning, Bella saw her friend Squeaky Squirrel. He was feeling very sad because the best nuts were too high for him to reach. Bella, with her kind heart, knew exactly what to do to help her little friend.

This heartwarming story shows how a simple act of kindness can make a big difference. And when Squeaky says "thank you," everyone feels happy! It's a gentle reminder for our little ones about empathy and the joy of showing appreciation.

Share this story with your little one and spread the warmth!
